lead.event: Indonesia's MSCI reclassification review prompts market warnings and institutional responses
lead.headline: MSCI review prompts warnings as IDX sets 82-stock IHSG removal for 2 November
lead.blurb: MSCI opened a consultation on 16 October on a proposed downgrade of Indonesia from Emerging Market to Standalone Market status, citing governance, trading, ownership-transparency and free-float data concerns. The IDX change takes effect 2 November. Bank Indonesia acknowledged foreign outflows from stocks, government bonds and SRBI, and said it was ready to use DNDF and spot interventions if they pressured the rupiah. Feedback is due by 30 April 2027, with MSCI’s final decision due by 30 June 2027.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from story to lead

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bank Rakyat Indonesia plans a second-phase share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BBRI plans second-phase buyback of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The program runs from 22 October to 21 January 2027. BRI plans to use repurchased shares for employee and/or board ownership programs, with transfers subject to approval at a General Meeting of Shareholders.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Indofood and Indofood CBP announce coordinated share buybacks
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: INDF and ICBP plan combined buybacks of up to Rp1.5 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Indofood and Indofood CBP will each allocate up to Rp750 billion from internal cash for purchases scheduled from 26 October to 31 December. After a full Rp750 billion buyback, pro forma EPS rises to Rp545 at Indofood and Rp321 at Indofood CBP, from Rp538 and Rp317, respectively.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: London Sumatra plans a Rp750 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: LSIP plans Rp750 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Assuming a full buyback, London Sumatra’s pro forma earnings per share rise from Rp131 to Rp141. The company plans to use internal cash for purchases from 26 October to 31 December, capped at 20% of paid-in capital and subject to free-float requirements.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Tabungan Negara expects slower second-half profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BBTN expects second-half profit growth to slow from first-half 40.8%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Tabungan Negara said rising funding costs, including deposit rates above 8% offered to large institutions, are pressuring industry profits. Its first-half net interest income fell 8% year on year to Rp8.59 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: Bukalapak reports third-quarter results and a net loss
earnings_guidance.headline: BUKA reports Rp885.8 billion net loss through Q3 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bukalapak's revenue rose 19.34% year on year to Rp5.64 trillion, but it swung from a Rp2.9 trillion profit to a loss. Gaming revenue rose 27% to Rp4.9 trillion while Mitra Bukalapak revenue fell 21% to Rp487 billion.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from lead to story

earnings_guidance.event: Remitra Global reports a profit surge as shares rally after suspension lift
earnings_guidance.headline: MKNT reports 1,090% profit surge as shares hit ARA after suspension lift
earnings_guidance.blurb: Remitra Global posted net profit of Rp15.15 billion for the period ended 30 September, reversing a Rp1.53 billion loss a year earlier, while net sales rose 8,397% to Rp312.69 billion. Shares resumed trading in the periodic call auction market on 19 October after the company completed obligations that had caused the suspension, then gained 20% for five consecutive sessions to Rp6.

earnings_guidance.event: ANTAM reports first-half results and continues studying a share buyback
earnings_guidance.headline: ANTM reports Rp6.91 trillion first-half profit and continues buyback study
earnings_guidance.blurb: Aneka Tambang's revenue rose 6.3% to Rp62.71 trillion and net profit increased 34% year on year. Corporate Secretary Wisnu Danandi Haryanto said the company is weighing market conditions, fundamentals, financial capacity and funding needs for operations and downstream development before deciding on a step.

macro_flows.event: Danantara begins buying shares on the Indonesia Stock Exchange
macro_flows.headline: Danantara begins buying IDX shares as IHSG falls 37.10% year to date
macro_flows.blurb: CIO Pandu Sjahrir says purchases target companies with attractive fundamentals and profit prospects. BRI Danareksa Sekuritas estimates up to US$1 billion (about Rp18 trillion) in added allocations through end-2026, on top of roughly US$3 billion already allocated to stocks and bonds. The broker says this would not sustainably support the IHSG.

deals_control.event: Trimegah Sekuritas raises its stake in Energi Mega Persada
deals_control.headline: TRIM raises ENRG stake to 11.24%
deals_control.blurb: Trimegah Sekuritas bought 421.57 million Energi Mega Persada shares through reverse repo transactions on 16 and 21 October for Rp380.55 billion, at Rp925 and Rp865 per share, respectively. Its holding rose from 10.72% (3.43 billion shares) to 11.24% (3.85 billion shares).
